title: Brookhaven, Stony Brook and Renaissance as a slush fund for secret science

tellings.quote: Do you think because I mean Brook Haven National Labs is the site of Cosmatron which is the largest particle accelerator in the US.

plain: The idea is that a cluster of Long Island institutions served as a hidden money pot for secret science: Brookhaven National Laboratory, a government research lab, the nearby Stony Brook university, and the investment firm Renaissance. Jesse Michels floats it as a question to a guest, pointing out that Brookhaven is home to the Cosmotron, which he calls the largest particle accelerator in the US. If he is right, serious physics could have been funded out of public view.
